Summary: Blocks kickoff approval when owners, milestones, or critical dependencies are still unclear.
PassCriteria: Kickoff artifacts identify accountable owners, milestones, risks, and next actions clearly enough to begin execution.
FailCriteria: Kickoff would close while core owners, milestones, or risks remain vague or unowned.
EscalationRule: Hold kickoff approval and escalate unresolved ownership or readiness gaps.
